BSc Medical Laboratory Technology
Department of Paramedical Sciences
Placement and Internship Report 2024-25

The department has a well-equipped laboratory and a qualified teaching faculty.
Eligible students: 120
Students placed: 96
Placement rate: 80%
Median salary: INR 4,20,000 per annum
Highest package: INR 6,50,000 per annum
Internships are included in the placement count.
The department maintains partnerships with three teaching hospitals in the city.
Laboratory facilities are available to all enrolled students throughout the programme.
The programme is affiliated to the state health university.
Students complete a supervised internship in semesters seven and eight.
Hostel accommodation is available on campus.
